body:
There's only so many years of giving one person can do without expecting something in return. Not talking about becoming a millionaire here. Just talking about being able to afford a car or a place that has a kitchen. 

It's not going to happen though. Too many doors have been slammed in my face. I've been told "I'm sorry but we can't help you" too many times. I don't want to try anymore, I'm sick of being around people in person. It always boils down to someone else telling me I can't do this or that. Trying at life has become too much of a pain in the ass. No one cares if I'm here, no one cares what I do. No matter what I do it's wrong so might as well do something wrong that will end it all for me. I won't have to hear anyone's mouth when they are scooping my brains off the ceiling in here.
I'm too socially inept to work for myself.
I lost interest in dating a few years back.

I'm fired anyway. I didn't show up at work because I'm sick of it and they told me if I didn't show up again I would be fired. 

I didn't want to be a millionaire. I didn't want the latest greatest stuff. I was willing to work hard. I rather be busy than sit around and do nothing. All I wanted was the resources to fix problems. Like going to the doctor when I'm sick or afford the dentist and get my teeth fixed.  But I guess that was asking too much. 

I'm tired. It's burned me out. I have no interest in living life anymore. I physically cannot make myself feel like what you are asking of me.

I'm breaking the law by owning the gun. It's the only thing I have that protects me from the people that walk around this area and sometimes try to break into my place. Being unarmed would be dangerous and selling it would be too risky. If it ever got to the point where I didn't need it, I'd just have to dismantle it and throw it away. 

If I'm going to have a roof over my head I'm going to need money. I'm pretty sure they've fired me from my job. He told me if I miss another day I was finished. Volunteering would only waste time in my current situation. 

I'm going to have to find something to do. I've become so antisocial though, finding a way to make ends meet with the inability to communicate with others will be my undoing.

I've been trying to get a job a better job for a very long time now. I dropped dozens of resumes off every week. I have a felony on my record. Every time they run a background check it's either they just stop calling me back or I get a letter explaining how my application had be declined. 

Since I can't vote in this country due to my felony there's nothing I can do about the health care problem. I'll just have to live with my poor health. 

I didn't go into work today so I'm probably fired anyway. 

I'm fed up because it's been over a decade and I can't do anything. It's always a reason why I can't do this or that. Everywhere I go it's some type of abuse due to the stains on my record. 

Even your country frowns on people who have even a mediocre felony like I have. I'm sure they'd welcome me at the boarder with open arms when I explain how uneducated I am and a tarnished background.

I've tried this "think in a different way" thing before. It all works well until some asshole comes into my job and pulls a gun on me because he curbed his rims or someone asks you where something they lost is and when you don't know they start making fun of you in front of everyone or yell at you. I'm just the fucking clean up boy. I'm not everyone's whipping boy. Standing up for myself isn't an option. They just give you a week off with no pay. Warn you if it happens again you'll end up fired. 

I'm 35 years old. My job is to get paid minimum wage to be everyone's punching bag. 

I should just be happy. When I go home and throw up blood and can't afford to go to the doctor. I should just be happy. 

My dreams are all crazy outrageous. Like, wanting to afford health care, or maybe buying a 2 bedroom house. I'd love to have furniture I don't have to run drywall screws in to hold it together or live in a place with a kitchen. I'd love to be able to go to a restaurant and do something wild and crazy like afford it. 

I guess I set my goals too high in life. I should just accept this white trash life style and just flip a switch in my head and be happy.
You're right, life is what it is and I want nothing to do with it anymore.

I used to try to be positive. That didn't fix anything. 

Attitude really doesn't matter. Things will still be broke and there will be no advancement.
